metadata.title: All-set-homogeneous geodesic spaces
metadata.abstract: A metric space is said to be all-set-homogeneous if any isometry between its subsets can be extended to an isometry of the whole space. We classify all-set-homogeneous geodesic spaces; in addition to the classical examples they include the universal metric trees of finite valence.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 极强齐性测地空间分类
analysis.workSummary: 分类任意子集间等距都能延拓为全空间等距的测地空间，除经典例子外包含有限分支数的普适度量树。
analysis.breakthrough: 刻画比有限点齐性更强的 all-set-homogeneity。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出完整分类表；不能把该性质等同于一般齐性或有限超齐性。
analysis.priorityReason: 刻画比有限点齐性更强的 all-set-homogeneity。
